entities.name: Sacerdos of Limoges
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Saint Sacerdos of Limoges is a French saint. He was born near Sarlat and became a monk. He was the founder and abbot of Calviac Abbey. He was later appointed bishop of Limoges and then of Sigüenza.
